references.text: The psalm that refers to the stone the builders rejected, which has become the cornerstone, parallels Jesus' use of parables to reveal the leaders' rejection of him.
Isaiah describes the house of Israel as God's vineyard, a direct parallel to Jesus' parable about the vineyard owner whose son is rejected, pointing to the leaders' rejection of Jesus.
Jesus' parable about the vineyard tenants who kill the son, directly related to the context of the verse.
The parable of the vineyard in Luke, which parallels Jesus' parable in Matthew, points to the leaders' rejection.
